name: doc-qa-agent
description: Hybrid retrieval over the Anthropic developer docs with grounded Claude citations.
long_description: Searches a Supabase + pgvector index of 80 Anthropic developer doc pages. Exposes three tools to any Claude client: search_docs (hybrid FTS + vector retrieval with reciprocal rank fusion), ask_docs (Claude Sonnet 4.6 with built-in citations over custom-content document blocks), and list_sources (corpus inventory). The same retrieval engine also powers a FastAPI /ask endpoint in the project.

python_path.title: Python interpreter (project venv)
python_path.description: Absolute path to the doc-qa-agent venv python.exe. Replace the placeholder default with the path on your machine. The server runs with this interpreter so it inherits the deps installed by pip install -e . (anthropic, voyageai, psycopg, pgvector, mcp).
